supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account v.rwong was created on DC-SUN-01 at 13:42:18 UTC by lena.ward; the creation event records the same logon ID as her RDP session to that domain controller.

lena.ward initiated RDP from WS-LWARD-01 to DC-SUN-01 and successfully logged on with a RemoteInteractive (type 10) session. This conflicts with the stated practice that remote administration is only done from WS-IDOYLE-01.
The created account follows the stated temporary-account naming pattern and was added to the Vendors group. The available records do not show an administrator-group addition.

At 14:11, lena.ward launched dsa.msc with a high-integrity token from WS-LWARD-01 and the process connected to DC-SUN-01 over RPC endpoint mapper and LDAP. These records show directory-management activity, but do not establish that it changed v.rwong or any other directory object.

known_telemetry_limitations: The evidence does not include an account-creation request, approval, or ticket to establish whether v.rwong was expected.
The records show an RDP logon and account-creation event, but do not establish lena.ward's intent or whether her credentials were used by her or someone else.
The available records do not show whether v.rwong later logged on, what access the account actually obtained, or whether additional group memberships were assigned outside the supplied evidence.
The later dsa.msc and LDAP/RPC events do not include directory-change details that would link them to v.rwong.
claims_not_established: Whether creation of v.rwong was authorized and tied to a legitimate vendor request.
Whether the RDP session from WS-LWARD-01 was an approved exception or unauthorized activity.
Whether v.rwong was used, granted additional privileges, or used for harmful purposes.
Whether the later directory-management activity affected the alerted account.
additional_evidence_needed: Check the account-provisioning request and approval records for v.rwong, including the intended owner, duration, and business purpose.
Review complete directory audit events for v.rwong's attributes, group memberships, subsequent modifications, and any deletion or disablement.
Review authentication and access logs for v.rwong after creation, including source hosts and accessed resources.
Verify whether lena.ward's RDP session to DC-SUN-01 and elevated dsa.msc use were approved; correlate with endpoint and domain-controller evidence for the interactive session.
Confirm whether the account was created through an approved help-desk workflow or through an exception to the stated remote-administration practice.
unrelated_findings: lena.ward opened the AWS console, and the proxy recorded a connection to console.aws.amazon.com; AWS is not among the approved services listed. This is separate from the account-creation alert and should be reviewed separately. Records: T238-00019, T238-00025.

The proxy recorded a POST to api.pagerduty.com, which is not among the approved services listed. This is separate from the account-creation alert and should be reviewed separately. Record: T238-00024.
